programme.title: 洪武三十二
programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆(陈山聪)，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风(谢天华)奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣(马德钟)的得力谋臣马三保(陈键锋)，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心。笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱(江若琳)却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备。失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三(徐子珊)和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中……

programme.title: 使徒行者
programme.desc: 总督察卓凯(苗侨伟)因战友死亡，发现一直联系的五名卧底全部失踪，由于他们掌握高度机密，卓凯决意追寻，卧底的黑白两道身分交错复杂，人人皆宣称为正义而战，但真正的正义又是谁来主宰？

programme.title: 使徒行者
programme.desc: 总督察卓凯(苗侨伟)因战友死亡，发现一直联系的五名卧底全部失踪，由于他们掌握高度机密，卓凯决意追寻，卧底的黑白两道身分交错复杂，人人皆宣称为正义而战，但真正的正义又是谁来主宰？

programme.title: 王老虎抢亲
programme.desc: 有勇无谋的王老虎(钱嘉乐)受不了母亲刘并蒂(黄淑仪)不时催婚的压力，误把男扮女装的周文宾(陈键锋)抢回府中作妻，卤莽把他暂置在亲妹王秀英(胡定欣)的闺房过了一夜，老虎为保妹妹名节，只好让文宾与秀英定亲，并立下苛刻规条折辱文宾；天资聪颖的文宾为求脱困，施计利用屠龙女侠武三娘(苏玉华)制衡老虎，误导三娘以为老虎正是她苦思多年的救命恩人，又设局让老虎再次抢亲，抢了三娘回府，二人成亲后，三娘为教好这只恶老虎，天天在王府上演驯悍记，把性情爆裂的老虎差点气疯；文宾成功脱离虎爪本应逍遥自在，却因自负强出头而掀起连场风波……当中人物情节皆一改传统剧目的固有步法，为【王老虎抢亲】谱出崭新局面……

programme.title: 不懂撒娇的女人
programme.desc: 点石成金的商场管理界女强人凌敏(宣萱)旗下商场获奖无数，更是个超级控制狂，堂妹凌禹勤(唐诗咏)作为她的头号助手，唯命是从、任劳任怨，更练出「伪撒娇」本领，为凌敏摆平不少麻烦。正当凌敏事业得意，有望晋身董事局时，公司竟请来商场推广界鬼才文念深(林文龙)与她平起平坐！这对爱恨交缠的前度情人在职场大斗法，凌敏不惜起用绰号「上海撒破郎」的美女实习生田蜜(高海宁)接近念深以套取情报，岂料田蜜不但觊觎凌敏的事业，更看上她的男人，两女展开激烈斗争！另一边，禹勤揭发花心男友何志超(黎诺懿)北上出轨，在灰心之时遇上最情深的暖男程日晖(王浩信)，以为能与他修成正果，却杀出个甜美温柔的台湾表妹向他表白，禹勤马上相形见拙！更糟糕的是，日晖似乎对婚姻异常恐惧，以结婚为志愿的禹勤，是否嫁杏无期？这对不懂撒娇、能干强悍的堂姊妹，最终是否能扭转厄运，获得幸福？

programme.title: 金宵大厦
programme.desc: 萧伟明(陈山聪饰)来到残旧且品流复杂的金宵大厦当看更，遇上这里的空姐住客Alex (李施桦饰)容貌竟与梦中一直缠绕自己的旗袍女子相同！阿萧接近Alex，了解更多彼此的关联。其间金宵大厦怪事不断，不停上演着其他住客的人生及奇幻故事；阿萧更发现Alex竟是一个残影！六十年代金宵舞厅的舞女COCO(李施桦分饰)，梦见自己未来当了空姐，恋上与梦中男子外貌相同的警察刘旭辉(陈山聪分饰)，奇梦还被书店主人林若思(张彦博饰)写成小说。阿萧一路追查，意外发现这本旧小说，惊悉自己与Alex有一段扑朔迷离的宿世情缘……

programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆(陈山聪)，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风(谢天华)奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣(马德钟)的得力谋臣马三保(陈键锋)，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心。笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱(江若琳)却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备。失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三(徐子珊)和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中……

programme.title: 使徒行者
programme.desc: 总督察卓凯(苗侨伟)因战友死亡，发现一直联系的五名卧底全部失踪，由于他们掌握高度机密，卓凯决意追寻，卧底的黑白两道身分交错复杂，人人皆宣称为正义而战，但真正的正义又是谁来主宰？

programme.title: 使徒行者

programme.title: 王老虎抢亲
programme.desc: 有勇无谋的王老虎(钱嘉乐)受不了母亲刘并蒂(黄淑仪)不时催婚的压力，误把男扮女装的周文宾(陈键锋)抢回府中作妻，卤莽把他暂置在亲妹王秀英(胡定欣)的闺房过了一夜，老虎为保妹妹名节，只好让文宾与秀英定亲，并立下苛刻规条折辱文宾；天资聪颖的文宾为求脱困，施计利用屠龙女侠武三娘(苏玉华)制衡老虎，误导三娘以为老虎正是她苦思多年的救命恩人，又设局让老虎再次抢亲，抢了三娘回府，二人成亲后，三娘为教好这只恶老虎，天天在王府上演驯悍记，把性情爆裂的老虎差点气疯；文宾成功脱离虎爪本应逍遥自在，却因自负强出头而掀起连场风波……当中人物情节皆一改传统剧目的固有步法，为【王老虎抢亲】谱出崭新局面……

programme.title: 不懂撒娇的女人
programme.desc: 点石成金的商场管理界女强人凌敏(宣萱)旗下商场获奖无数，更是个超级控制狂，堂妹凌禹勤(唐诗咏)作为她的头号助手，唯命是从、任劳任怨，更练出「伪撒娇」本领，为凌敏摆平不少麻烦。正当凌敏事业得意，有望晋身董事局时，公司竟请来商场推广界鬼才文念深(林文龙)与她平起平坐！这对爱恨交缠的前度情人在职场大斗法，凌敏不惜起用绰号「上海撒破郎」的美女实习生田蜜(高海宁)接近念深以套取情报，岂料田蜜不但觊觎凌敏的事业，更看上她的男人，两女展开激烈斗争！另一边，禹勤揭发花心男友何志超(黎诺懿)北上出轨，在灰心之时遇上最情深的暖男程日晖(王浩信)，以为能与他修成正果，却杀出个甜美温柔的台湾表妹向他表白，禹勤马上相形见拙！更糟糕的是，日晖似乎对婚姻异常恐惧，以结婚为志愿的禹勤，是否嫁杏无期？这对不懂撒娇、能干强悍的堂姊妹，最终是否能扭转厄运，获得幸福？

programme.desc: 有勇无谋的王老虎(钱嘉乐)受不了母亲刘并蒂(黄淑仪)不时催婚的压力，误把男扮女装的周文宾(陈键锋)抢回府中作妻，卤莽把他暂置在亲妹王秀英(胡定欣)的闺房过了一夜，老虎为保妹妹名节，只好让文宾与秀英定亲，并立下苛刻规条折辱文宾；天资聪颖的文宾为求脱困，施计利用屠龙女侠武三娘(苏玉华)制衡老虎，误导三娘以为老虎正是她苦思多年的救命恩人，又设局让老虎再次抢亲，抢了三娘回府，二人成亲后，三娘为教好这只恶老虎，天天在王府上演驯悍记，把性情爆裂的老虎差点气疯；文宾成功脱离虎爪本应逍遥自在，却因自负强出头而掀起连场风波……当中人物情节皆一改传统剧目的固有步法，为【王老虎抢亲】谱出崭新局面……

programme.title: 不懂撒娇的女人
programme.desc: 点石成金的商场管理界女强人凌敏(宣萱)旗下商场获奖无数，更是个超级控制狂，堂妹凌禹勤(唐诗咏)作为她的头号助手，唯命是从、任劳任怨，更练出「伪撒娇」本领，为凌敏摆平不少麻烦。正当凌敏事业得意，有望晋身董事局时，公司竟请来商场推广界鬼才文念深(林文龙)与她平起平坐！这对爱恨交缠的前度情人在职场大斗法，凌敏不惜起用绰号「上海撒破郎」的美女实习生田蜜(高海宁)接近念深以套取情报，岂料田蜜不但觊觎凌敏的事业，更看上她的男人，两女展开激烈斗争！另一边，禹勤揭发花心男友何志超(黎诺懿)北上出轨，在灰心之时遇上最情深的暖男程日晖(王浩信)，以为能与他修成正果，却杀出个甜美温柔的台湾表妹向他表白，禹勤马上相形见拙！更糟糕的是，日晖似乎对婚姻异常恐惧，以结婚为志愿的禹勤，是否嫁杏无期？这对不懂撒娇、能干强悍的堂姊妹，最终是否能扭转厄运，获得幸福？

programme.title: 金宵大厦
programme.desc: 萧伟明(陈山聪饰)来到残旧且品流复杂的金宵大厦当看更，遇上这里的空姐住客Alex (李施桦饰)容貌竟与梦中一直缠绕自己的旗袍女子相同！阿萧接近Alex，了解更多彼此的关联。其间金宵大厦怪事不断，不停上演着其他住客的人生及奇幻故事；阿萧更发现Alex竟是一个残影！六十年代金宵舞厅的舞女COCO(李施桦分饰)，梦见自己未来当了空姐，恋上与梦中男子外貌相同的警察刘旭辉(陈山聪分饰)，奇梦还被书店主人林若思(张彦博饰)写成小说。阿萧一路追查，意外发现这本旧小说，惊悉自己与Alex有一段扑朔迷离的宿世情缘……

programme.title: 洪武三十二
programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆(陈山聪)，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风(谢天华)奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣(马德钟)的得力谋臣马三保(陈键锋)，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心。笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱(江若琳)却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备。失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三(徐子珊)和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中……

However, before everything is sold out, Ajeng leaves Acan’s cart unattended, and a little boy eats Acan’s steamed buns without paying. Frustrated, Acan left, taking his cart with him. When Ajeng arrived home, she found that Beno (Edwin Syarief)—the man she was to be matched with—was already there

programme.title: 倾国倾城
programme.desc: 李翰祥史诗式电影，艺术成就及导演功力震惊中港台三地。本片荣获金马优等剧情片、最佳女主角及最佳彩色影片美术设计奖项。影后卢燕饰慈禧太后；处女演出即成名的萧瑶，饰死后受追封为贵妃的珍妃；而为珍妃逝世而不近女色的光绪帝则是狄龙。

programme.title: 小云雀
programme.desc: 记者仕泰为发掘歌星小云雀的秘密，假扮大亨接近小云雀。后来仕泰的假大亨身份被揭穿，小云雀大怒，请来真正大亨揭穿仕泰的身份。怎料大亨很欣赏仕泰的应变能力，实时聘请他为助手，处理歌星登台事宜。

programme.title: 十二金牌
programme.desc: 南宋年间，朝廷腐败积弱，加上金兵南侵，民生困苦。一代名将岳飞赤胆忠肝，率领岳家军奋勇抗敌，大破金兵，深受百姓爱戴。宋朝丞相秦桧卖国求荣，勾结金国四王子金兀术，设计对付岳飞，以扫除金人入侵中原的最大阻碍。宋高宗为保帝位，纵容秦桧只手遮天，更听从其谗言发出十二道金牌急召岳飞回京。岳飞长子岳云、次子岳雷与王八妹等江湖侠士，为挽救国家危难，千方百计阻截金牌，与秦桧爪牙爆发一场腥风血雨的死战…

programme.title: 钻石艳盗
programme.desc: 两大珠宝盗贼「夜来香」和「夜爵士」前往日本，意图偷去「维纳斯的眼泪」巨钻。二人见面后即坠入爱河，却不知道原来对方同为盗取巨钻的竞敌。最后谁会得到巨钻？二人的恋情又会否无疾而终？

programme.title: 笑傲江湖
programme.desc: 华山派大弟子令狐冲要找出一个继承「笑傲江湖」琴谱的人。当令狐冲发现任盈盈为合适人选时，却发现她竟是魔教教主任我行之女，同时他亦一步步卷入正邪两道的权斗阴谋和道义两难的困境。

programme.title: 茅山僵尸拳
programme.desc: 以「赶尸」为业的陈师父与徒弟受托押运九具僵尸，启程上路。未料途中两具竟逃脱。其中一具实际上并非僵尸，而是为躲避敌人追杀而假扮的江湖豪客。更令人意外的是，此人与陈师父同样身怀绝技，二人皆为深不可测的武林高手！

programme.title: 马哥波罗
programme.desc: 故事描述东游至中国的马哥波罗，听从元世祖忽必烈忠告，到中国各地考察三年，回京后，适逢忽遭反元志士刺杀，幸得蒙古高手护驾，一死一逃；马凭死者遗言，判断余党必在扬州；马被任命为总督，率兵将反元者一网打尽；惟马抵扬后，有感于汉人抗异族的无比决心，遂将蒙兵来攻之事暗告反元志士...

programme.title: 倩女幽魂
programme.desc: 年轻书生宁采臣在传说闹鬼的恐怖寺庙里过夜。虽然他不相信传闻，却遇上美丽的女鬼聂小倩。原来聂小倩被困在寺庙中，诱使年轻男子给魔头姥姥享用。宁采臣得悉聂小倩为一只善良的女鬼，于是决定助她逃离魔掌。

programme.title: 武林风云
programme.desc: 故事描述，武义亲王恃势弄权，为夺紫光剑，不惜害死甘大雄、迫走徐牧，并命其子鲁天霞率恶家奴直闯甘家堡，借吊祭为名，实以武力夺剑。甘氏三女胜男、亚男、超男惶然之际，表亲徐进到访，联手杀退恶奴，但大战中，徐进、胜男等受伤，无恙的亚男遂往飞虎岭邀救兵……

programme.title: 军阀趣史
programme.desc: 此片可谓李翰祥导演，经典作《大军阀》之延续，焦点在几位当时得令的艳星，余莎莉、邵音音及楚湘云。片中「艳趣」特别多…

programme.title: 保镖
programme.desc: 洛阳无敌庄庄主失去了所有功力，于是请来侄儿与未婚妻一起护送黄金前往京城。在途中，他们遇到了一名神秘侠客，三人随即联手对抗盗匪，竭力保护黄金不被劫走。

programme.title: 鳄鱼河
programme.desc: 这个故事洋溢着《罗密欧与茱丽叶》般的悲恋色彩。两个世代积怨已深的家族，被一条遍布鳄鱼的河流阻隔，谁也不愿筑桥往来。然而，命运却让两家子女在大学里邂逅并深深相爱。为了相守，他们不仅必须跨越险恶的河流，更要化解两个家族间延续多年的仇恨。

programme.title: Tooth on the Loose / That Thing You Dew
programme.desc: When Phoebe convinces the Tooth Fairy to visit before Marcus has actually lost his tooth, the Dew Drops do everything in their power to make sure the tooth is out before she arrives! / The Dews decide to hold a concert in the park for their animal friends, but can’t find the time to practice.

programme.title: Dollhouse Fairy Tales
programme.desc: The Gabby Cats put their own spin on the classic fairytales "Rapunzel," "The Princess and the Pea," and "Little Red Riding Hood." For the Cat of the Day Segment, CatRat sings a song!

programme.title: Happy CAT-O-Ween
programme.desc: It’s Cat-O-Ween in the dollhouse, and all the Gabby Cats are in the holiday spirit. Gabby and Pandy dress up and go trick-or-treating around the dollhouse, where they make cat-o-lanterns with Baby Box, search for hidden treats with MerCat, and make Banana ghosts with Cakey. Along the way, CatRat plays silly tricks on them, but in the end Floyd manages to trick them all! For the Cat of the Day segment, all the Gabby Cats sing a special Cat-O-Ween song.

programme.title: A Tadpole Tale
programme.desc: When fun-loving, water-dwelling tadpole LALA shows up in Gloria’s tank, the two become underwater besties! But when Molly wants Gloria to spend “Palentine’s Day” with her, Gloria can’t admit she’s already made plans to spend it with her “land” friends and runs herself ragged running back and forth between Molly and the gang. Gloria’s attempts to make everyone happy backfire, leading her to learn that she can have different groups of friends, and it’s okay to play with them one at a time, or all

programme.title: Groundhog Day
programme.desc: Gloria wants spring to come! She’s SICK of winter and is counting down the days until the Central Park pond melts so she can retrieve a toy she lost in the water before it froze! So when Goldie the Groundhog predicts more winter, Gloria sets out to make spring come, by any means necessary! When she fails at controlling the weather, Gloria learns that when something doesn’t go your way, embrace Plan B!

programme.desc: Rumors of scary sea monsters in the East End take the kids on a journey of discovering you shouldn’t believe everything you hear. / Mysterious globs disturbing the ocean turn out to be the byproduct of food from Unicorn Land.

programme.title: Chef J's Tale
programme.desc: Chef J tells a tale about unicorns sailing in ships on clouds in search of Unicorn Land.

But when Kit realizes she accidentally scratched up Frank and Beans’s tree, she, Tag and Scooch find a way to make it up to them.

programme.title: The Itch To Switch / Mismatched Socks
programme.desc: When Tag is frustrated living in a crowded house, and Scooch is bored in a quiet house, the two friends switch houses for the day. At first they both love their new lives. programme.title: Photo Day Disaster / The Eightful Eight

programme.desc: When Jim is unavailable to do a simple Trollhunter task Toby and Claire take on the responsibility to prove they can carry their weight... literally.

programme.desc: When Stuart’s larger-than-life ex-girlfriend surprises him with a visit, Aja, Steve, Vex, and Nana join them on a triple date— where issues from each of their relationships come to a head. Meanwhile, Krel, Toby, and Eli discover a new passion: Sci-Fi filmmaking.

programme.title: Asteroid Rage
programme.desc: With an asteroid hurdling toward Earth, threatening to destroy Arcadia Oaks, Aja and Krel must join forces with Area 49-B -- Colonel Kubritz and Tronos -- to stop it. These strange bedfellows might save the town, but this alliance comes at a cost.

programme.title: Lugg's Day Out
programme.desc: Krel finally gets the wormhole generator working, only for Luug to eat it! The Royals race to catch their teleporting pup before their secret alien identities are uncovered. But the chase for Luug uncovers something far worse… Morando is on Earth.

programme.desc: Boss Baby is framed for leaking info about the Stinkless Serum to PuppyCo and must flee on the run via Errand Day with the family

programme.title: El Apasionado Negocio de la Niñera
programme.desc: Frederic makes a play to take over the town's babysitters by instituting "senior sitting"

programme.title: New Tail
programme.desc: D-Structs loses his wrecking ball tail and wants to prove he's still dangerous, but when he gets stuck the crew must decide if they will save him.

programme.title: Ottos
programme.desc: When a meteor crashes into the Wrenchtools' home, the Dinotrux take them to safe ground; little do they know D-Structs is planning a giant attack.

programme.desc: A group of fire ants swarm the city and it's up to Burn to race their leader in order to get them to leave. programme.title: Fleshed Out / Messy Business At The Manor
programme.desc: Fleshed Out Wolfie wakes up one morning to every creature's nightmare?he's turned into a human! Messy Business At The Manor When Mosshead has nowhere to go for vacation, Casper invites him to stay at his uncles' house…where he quickly discovers that Mosshead is the world's worst houseguest.

programme.title: Paramedic Paranormal / Back To Ghoul
programme.desc: Paramedic Paranormal When Jimmy breaks out in hives, Casper and his friends have no choice but to bring him to the human hospital. Back To Ghoul When Casper's uncles Stinky, Fatso and Stretch decide to go back to Scare School, Casper is thrilled.

programme.title: DJ Catnip Gets His Groove Back
programme.desc: Gabby brings DJ Catnip a microphone for him to use in the big music show, but he has some terrible news: he lost his groove! Determined to help him get his groove back, Gabby and Pandy take him on a musical search through the dollhouse. As they go, Gabby uses the microphone to record sounds from the Gabby Cats’ everyday activities that culminate into a new song that gets DJ his groove back just in time for the show! In our Gabby Cat of the Day Segment, Gabby sings a song!

programme.title: Where’s The Party? / The Noisiest Night
programme.desc: When Marcus loses an invitation to a birthday party and doesn’t know where it will take place, the Dew Drops set out to find the location and get Marcus to the party on time. / When Harper can’t sleep because of a strange noise in her room, the Dews must figure out the source.

programme.title: Escape The Backpack / Play Date
programme.desc: While helping Lola pack for her first day of camp, the Dews get stuck inside her backpack! Using the random items inside, the Dews get crafty in their attempt to break out. / When Eden and Phoebe join Harper and Marcus for a playdate, the Dews disagree on what activity their kids should do, ultimately learning that there are lots of ways to play!

programme.title: A Cat-Tabulous Christmas
programme.desc: It's Christmas time in the dollhouse! After putting the final topper on the Christmas tree, Figgy the Elf calls and says that Santa Kitty needs help in his workshop, it's up to Gabby and Pandy to go help her out. After some toy fixing and boxing fun, Gabby and Pandy get to meet Santa Kitty and his Kitty reindeer and join him delivering presents to all their friends in the dollhouse.

programme.title: Spaceship
programme.desc: The dollhouse delivery is a spaceship that takes off with a sleeping CatRat inside! Gabby, Pandy, and Kitty Fairy have to get the ship back into The Fairy Tail Garden before Floyd (who thinks it's the best kitty toy ever!) gets his paws on it!

programme.title: A Roar Is Born
programme.desc: Alex lands a role in a big Hollywood movie, but his part is threatened by a diva-like bull. Alex nearly gives up, but with the help of his friends, learns that no one can bully him out of what he loves to do.

programme.title: The First Lost Tooth
programme.desc: When Melman loses his first tooth, he fears he won't be Kate's baby anymore and goes on a city-wide chase to recover his tooth before Kate can replace him with a younger, cuter animal.

programme.title: Best Friends Day / The White Whale
programme.desc: Pixie loves to ride the clouds, but she can't understand why Kelp doesn’t love it, too. If they don't agree on this, does that mean they're not best friends anymore? / Kelp helps Ollie fulfill his dream of watching the white whale migration.

programme.title: Shark and Pilot Fish / Theo
programme.desc: When shark and pilot fish are separated it’s up to Kelp, Scallop, Cruz, and Waverly to help them find each other again. / Scallop’s friend Theo finally comes clean on why he’s always rushing off.

programme.title: Bigpaw, Big Problems / Captain Scooch and Scally-Tag
programme.desc: Tag, Scooch and Kit think they found the perfect story for their newspaper: Bigpaw is in Pawston! Tag struggles to take orders as first mate while helping Scooch navigate maritime obstacles and avoid the fearsome pirates.

programme.title: Double Booked / Gym Enemy Cricket
programme.desc: When both Sam and Gabriel pre-order the new Commander Kale comic but the supplier only sends one copy, TZG secretly ferries the comic book back and forth between readers. / When Fawna teaches a silent yoga class, TZG secretly find and remove a loud chirping cricket from the Community Center.

programme.desc: With a little help from Gabby’s imagination, a sparkly toy banana turns into a magical Rainy Day Banana that helps Gabby and the Gabby Cats have fun on a rainy day! They have silly banana snacks with Cakey, make crafts to tell a story with Baby Box, and have an a-meow-zing banana dance party with DJ Catnip. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Cakey sings a song!

programme.desc: Big Oil is bringing big improvements to the school. But new track stables, an upgraded veterinary lab and dorm rooms come at a cost — and spark disaster.

programme.title: Science Vs. Nature
programme.desc: The Dragon riders enlist the aid of Carla and Hazel and their scientific knowledge to help them prepare for a mission to neutralize Jörmungandr so they can return him to his chamber and seal him back inside.

programme.title: Ball in Cup
programme.desc: When Phil invents a simple new game called ball-in-cup, everyone except Hope, can't stop playing it. But just when Hope thinks she's rid the farm of the game, she finds herself addicted to the game worst of all.

programme.title: Cave New World
programme.desc: When the adults exclude the kids from their adult-only cave, the kids make their own much cooler cave, soon making the adults want to switch caves.

programme.title: Ba-Ba Town
programme.desc: The Templeton’s hometown is overtaken by baby criminals, with Temp Baby Aubrey in charge. Boss has 48 hours to somehow restore them all to adulthood and turn them in, or face jail time himself. With Tina now acting like a dark angel of vengeance after feeling betrayed by Aubrey, Boss is forced to assemble a team from unlikely odd friends. Together, they launch a final mission to settle old scores and clear Boss Baby’s name.

programme.title: The Business Boss: Back in Baby
programme.desc: After the events of the Boss Baby 2 film, adult businessman Theodore Templeton is framed for embezzling from his company and forced to revert back to his old Boss Baby self and crash with his brother Tim. programme.desc: The only way that Jim can remove Stricklers ring is if he stops time but he uses the time stopping artefact too soon..

programme.desc: 一条街隔开两个世界。一边是努力生活有苦也有笑的市场人生，一边是勾心斗角有钱却战战兢兢的豪门日子。

programme.title: 一念关山
programme.desc: 李同光的突然介入让局势再生变化，他表面上与宁远舟合作，却始终令人难以捉摸。任如意则从他的举动中察觉异样，决定暗中调查，希望找出隐藏在背后的真正目的。

programme.title: 综艺玩很大
programme.desc: 综艺天王吴宗宪与超人气主持KID林柏昇联手合作，艺人分成两队挑战各式关卡，节目充满趣味性，更借外景地点的不同，带领观众深入了解各地风土民情。

programme.title: 太阳星辰
programme.desc: 陈凯晴意外发现数名受害者之间存在隐秘联系，也让原本独立的案件逐渐串连起来。与杨光耀并肩调查的过程中，她开始相信这位老警探的不只是经验，还有对真相始终不变的执着。

programme.title: 一念关山
programme.desc: 李同光的突然介入让局势再生变化，他表面上与宁远舟合作，却始终令人难以捉摸。任如意则从他的举动中察觉异样，决定暗中调查，希望找出隐藏在背后的真正目的。

programme.title: 虚拟特攻
programme.desc: 金牌保镖龙威在妻子惨死后患上了创伤后应激障碍，心情低落。他意外结识高科技公司职员Amy，在她邀请下参加了新产品的虚拟测试。龙威测试成功后即成为该公司的虚拟特攻，更获试用新发明的防护机甲，不料遭遇神秘武装人员入侵，一场生死大战即将展开…

programme.title: 青木劫
programme.desc: 民国初年，富甲一方的康氏惨遭灭门，唯一的目击证人—家中的幼女—在亲眼目睹全家被杀后离奇失踪。几十年间，位于青木巷的废弃康宅充斥着灵异惊悚的气氛。随着真相逐渐揭露，这个恐怖的疑团交织着复仇与死亡的动机。

programme.title: 九龙城寨
programme.desc: 曾是东北街头武霸的阿能为了出人头地，洗心革面来到香港的九龙城寨从零开始打拼，不料却卷入一场黑恶势力间的阴谋和混战。最终为保护被黑恶势力追杀的好朋友，阿能重拾自我，挺身而出，与城寨居民一同对抗黑恶势力，誓死保卫朋友。

programme.title: 十万火急
programme.desc: 这是关于香港消防员的英勇救火故事。勇敢的消防员无惧冲天大火，肩负救灾扶危的重任，甚至舍身救人。但当消防员脱下制服后，是否仍同样勇敢地面对自身的难题呢？

programme.title: 六耳猕猴
programme.desc: 生命之树被烧毁后，世间陷入一片混沌。为拯救苍生，孙悟空决定回到过去，帮助生命之树复活。因为失去了金箍棒，孙悟空力量时有时无，只得找回儿时的自己，一同前往寻找时间之力。不料，六耳猕猴却想据为己有，两人就此爆发激战。

programme.title: 百变星君
programme.desc: 富家子李泽星挂名留学，实际上却挥金如土，并自命情圣，称霸校园。一日，因搭上黑帮老大情妇Silvia，而遭黑帮刺杀，被炸得粉身碎骨。这个财大气粗的李泽星以百变金刚之姿态复活，还掌握了独特的能力，得到一份真正的工作，还有他真心爱上的意中人。

programme.title: 冰封侠之时空行者
programme.desc: 《冰封侠：时空行者》承接前作，四位明朝锦衣卫在现代香港苏醒。为修正历史，贺英独自踏上了寻找「时空金球」的凶险旅程，却不知自己正一步步堕入精心布下的致命陷阱。

programme.title: 鹿鼎记 II
programme.desc: 「神龙教」教主龙儿奉命协助吴三桂推翻康熙皇帝，却反遭吴三桂陷害，幸得韦小宝相救才得以保命。于是龙儿以身相许，并把绝世武功传于韦小宝以对付吴三桂。最后，韦小宝更意外地从四十二章经中得知满清龙脉的秘密宝藏。

programme.title: 多乐路
programme.desc: 东北某小城，一家麻辣汤馆每天都迎来不同的客人。这些客人中有如胶似漆的小情侣，两名放荡不羁的青年和一位的士司机。他们本是毫无交集的人，却因为一场交通事故牵扯在一起…

programme.title: 消失的子弹
programme.desc: 民国初年，一家兵工厂发生离奇连环命案。死者皆死于枪击，现场却遍寻不到弹头，引发幽灵子弹索命恐慌。警政官松东路与热血神枪手郭追受命联手侦破此案。随着调查深入，两人发现阿森纳内黑幕重重，而真相竟隐藏在一个关于正义与人性堕落的惊人诡计之中。

programme.title: 无敌幸运星
programme.desc: 富翁死前立下遗嘱，把财富全留给女儿飞飞，逼使其子秋少及侄儿大傻设法分一杯羹。大傻派小混混幸运星往偷遗嘱，欲在遗嘱上做手脚，而秋少亦找来貌似其妹的阿凤假扮飞飞骗取遗嘱。幸运星打算骗”假飞飞”结婚以夺取遗产，不料二人日久生情，最终幸运星在婚礼日揭发二人的诡计。

programme.title: 灵幻先生

programme.desc: 由幽默风趣的吴宗宪、陈汉典、黃路梓茵联手主持带您闹翻天！最强综艺节目保证娱乐性十足，让你笑声不断，千万别错过。

programme.title: 幸福来了
programme.desc: 高家兄弟因为价值观截然不同，不但成就高低立判，连教育出来的子女，个性和品格也大相径庭。上一代有上一代的恩怨情报，下一代有下一代的追求展望；在错综复杂的人生大道上，每个人都汲汲营营，寻找着属于自己的幸福课题。

programme.title: 多情城市
programme.desc: 以1960至1970年代九份为背景，述说三个拜把兄弟如何赤手空拳打天下，藉由上一代的爱情故事串连两代之间共同的情感与记忆，深度探索两代之间的价值观差异。
